subject.title: ci(cloudflare): deploy crawl-remote from protected ClawSweeper environment

question: Do repository owners approve making the protected ClawSweeper environment and the explicitly named dispatcher the sole crawl-remote production deployment authority under this migration and rollback contract?
rationale: Technical review can verify enforcement, but it cannot authorize the long-term credential custodian, sole operator, or cross-repository incident-recovery responsibility.

options.title: Approve the narrow authority
options.body: Merge the workflow fail-closed, coordinate the companion retirement, provision the protected environment, and supervise the first rollout after independent owner sign-off.

options.title: Generalize operator authorization
options.body: Replace the individual actor gate with an owner-approved durable authorization mechanism while preserving the protected workflow boundary.

options.title: Retain service-owned deployment
options.body: Do not complete the cutover if maintainers do not accept the cross-repository credential and recovery ownership.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow authority
recommendation.body: Merge the workflow fail-closed, coordinate the companion retirement, provision the protected environment, and supervise the first rollout after independent owner sign-off.

likelyOwner.reason: The previous completed review identified steipete as the best available independent decision owner separate from the workflow designer and named dispatcher.
